as_told.title: Iranian pilot fires at a UAP and goes down

plain: An Iranian fighter pilot named Parviz Jafari is said to have had a dramatic UFO encounter over Tehran in the mid 1970s while flying an F-4 Phantom jet, a case also studied by the Defense Intelligence Agency, a US military spy office. The UFO investigator James Fox says he met Jafari himself, through the writer Leslie Kean, and dates it to around 1975, while Michels later retells it from Fox as a 1979 case in which the pilot fired at the object. If true, it would be a military pilot facing an object he could not stop.
